caseName: Loomis v. First Federal Savings & Loan Ass'n
caseNameFull: Loomis v. First Federal Savings & Loan Assn.

opinions.text: The motion to substitute is granted and John E. Martin, present Attorney General of Wisconsin, is substituted as a party petitioner in the place and stead of Orland S. Loomis, former Attorney General of Wisconsin.
